name: SeeSignal
summary:
Gain the superpower to see and feel WiFi! This mixed reality app fills your room with holograms that show the quality of your network in real-time. Discover dead zones, find the strongest signal, and learn how wireless moves through space - all to help improve streaming, working, and gaming.

- See Invisible Signals: Watch your WiFi come to life with easy-to-understand visuals.
- Map Your Network: Find weak spots, strong spots, and see your full coverage.
- Pinpoint the Best Signal: Quickly locate the area
